description: This Java source file defines the ProductAvailability class, which models the availability details of a product in an e-commerce system, including quantity, availability date, region, pricing, and shipping info.

classes.name: ProductAvailability
classes.description: Entity class representing product availability, including quantity, date, region, status, pricing, and shipping options.

methods.name: getProductQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the product available.

methods.name: setProductQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product available.

methods.name: getProductDateAvailable
methods.description: Returns the date when the product is available.

methods.name: setProductDateAvailable
methods.description: Sets the date when the product is available.

methods.name: getRegion
methods.description: Returns the region associated with this availability.

methods.name: setRegion
methods.description: Sets the region associated with this availability.

methods.name: getRegionVariant
methods.description: Returns the region variant.

methods.name: setRegionVariant
methods.description: Sets the region variant.

methods.name: getProductStatus
methods.description: Returns the status indicating if the product is available.

methods.name: setProductStatus
methods.description: Sets the product's availability status.

methods.name: getProductIsAlwaysFreeShipping
methods.description: Returns whether the product always has free shipping.

methods.name: setProductIsAlwaysFreeShipping
methods.description: Sets whether the product always has free shipping.

methods.name: getProductQuantityOrderMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum order quantity.

methods.name: setProductQuantityOrderMin
methods.description: Sets the minimum order quantity.

methods.name: getProductQuantityOrderMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum order quantity.

methods.name: setProductQuantityOrderMax
methods.description: Sets the maximum order quantity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Gets the primary key ID of the availability record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key ID.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the associated product entity.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a product with this availability record.

methods.name: getPrices
methods.description: Returns the set of product prices related to this availability.

methods.name: setPrices
methods.description: Sets the prices related to this availability.
